title: In 1884, 21 Elephants Walked Across the Brooklyn Bridge

scenes.text: In 1884, twenty-one elephants walked across the Brooklyn Bridge.
People feared the new bridge might collapse.
A stampede on opening week had killed twelve people.
Showman P. T. Barnum had a plan to prove the bridge was safe.
He marched his elephants across, plus camels and dromedaries.
Twenty-one elephants. One bridge. Still standing today.

description:
In 1884, twenty-one elephants walked across the Brooklyn Bridge.
Showman P. T. Barnum led his circus across to prove the bridge was safe after a deadly stampede the year before.
Would you have watched from the shore?
first_comment: Bonus: Barnum also brought seven camels and ten dromedaries. Would you have crossed behind them?
